title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos with Avocado
summary: A colourful vegan Mexican-inspired dinner of smoky roasted sweet potato, spiced black beans and creamy avocado tucked into warm corn tortillas. It is hearty, fresh and ideal for an easy weeknight taco night.

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Put the sweet potato cubes on a large baking tray and toss with 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, the paprika, chilli powder, 3/4 tsp salt and the black pepper until evenly coated.
Roast the sweet potatoes for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until browned at the edges and tender all the way through.

Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add half the diced red onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Stir in the black beans, remaining 1 tsp cumin, remaining 1/4 tsp salt and 2 tbsp water. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot and slightly creamy; lightly mash a few beans with the spoon to thicken.
Mix the remaining red onion with the cherry tomatoes, coriander and 1 tbsp lime juice to make a quick salsa.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry frying pan for 20–30 seconds per side, until soft and lightly toasted in spots.
Fill each tortilla with roasted sweet potato and black beans. Top with avocado slices, tomato salsa, jalapeno and the remaining lime juice, then serve immediately.
